name: @ahmed.tawfik.galal/ai-design-system
description: An AI-ready design system specification: 223 design tokens, 34 component specs and 8 UX patterns in machine-readable JSON, with source attribution, WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility and Arabic/RTL rules. Built on an unofficial Fly Emirates concept.
disclaimer: Unofficial concept. Emirates brand guidelines are not public; the logo and typefaces are proprietary. Nothing here is endorsed by Emirates. Only values with confidence "official" come from Emirates sources; "observed" values were read from the live site by a third party; "inferred" values are unverified; "proposed" values are design-system recommendations.

confidence.official: Directly supported by verified Emirates documentation.
confidence.observed: Identified by inspecting an Emirates digital experience (the live website).
confidence.inferred: Unverified third-party claim or interpretation (File A).
confidence.proposed: A design-system recommendation (Rec). approved: true marks recommendations approved over an observed value.
confidence.unattributed: The source documents give no source for this value (e.g. a mobile size in a row tagged only for desktop).

vocabulary.tokenConfidence: For tokens, confidence is that of the base (:root) value; source.modes lists breakpoint or Arabic values whose confidence differs.

status.specification: complete = props, states and accessibility documented; partial = described but not fully specified.
status.designed: A Figma or equivalent design exists. false for every component in this version.
status.implemented: Production code exists. false for every component in this version.
status.tested: Automated and accessibility tests exist. false for every component in this version.

layers.primitive: Tier 1. Part of the design system.
layers.composite: Tier 2. Part of the design system.
layers.feature: Assembled in the product from design-system parts. Specified here for completeness; not part of the design system (scope-boundaries).

Schema for each pattern spec.
Shared definitions (source attribution, status, ids).
All design tokens: W3C DTCG values plus exact CSS output, breakpoint and Arabic values, attribution and component usage.
Compact lookup (one line per token): CSS name → value, resolved literal, breakpoint and Arabic values, confidence. Use this to resolve the tokens a spec lists without loading tokens.json.
CSS custom properties. Identical to design-system/tokens/tokens.css.
Arabic @font-face ("EK Arabic"). Load with tokens.css.
Every component with id, layer, status, relationships and path. Read this first, then fetch single specs.
One component specification.
Every page pattern, flow and state model.
One pattern specification.
Breakpoints, grid, containers, per-breakpoint adaptations, surface layers.
Source documents (with hashes), source-tag definitions and the decision log D1–D24.
Colour rules and hierarchy.
Type rules, scale and Arabic adjustments.
Spacing scale and units.
Radius, border widths, elevation and selection rules.
Icon set, sizes, aviation map and RTL mirroring.

Right-to-left and Arabic rules.
Package changes.

retrieval: Start with manifest.json, then components/index.json or patterns/index.json.
Fetch one component with components/{id}/spec.json (package export: ./components/{id}).
Resolve the tokens a spec lists with tokens/values.json (small, keyed by CSS name). Load tokens/tokens.json only for full attribution, DTCG references and usedBy.
Check provenance before presenting a value as Emirates brand fact: only confidence "official" is an Emirates source.
notImplemented: Storybook stories and automated tests (tested: false everywhere)
Pricing / seat-map / booking API contracts (the specs define client state and responsibilities only)
MCP server, CLI or code generators
